title: ServiceAnnouncement
description: POST body for /api/owners/announce (and the legacy /api/owners/beacon alias). Persisted in BEACON_STORE KV. Disambiguated from chittybeacon (the health-poller worker) — this is a deploy-receiver shape.

service.description: Lowercase service name. Should match an entry in canon.baseline_services if known to canon.

version.description: Free-form version. Recommended: semver, but git short SHA is also acceptable.

gitSha.description: Git commit SHA the deployment was built from.

lastMigration.description: Filename of the most recent migration applied (e.g. '0019_document_case_id.sql').

deployedAt.description: When the deploy completed. Defaults to receivedAt if omitted.

receivedAt.description: Server-side stamp; ignored on input, set by chittyschema.
